name: Progress overview
summary: Progress as it stood on a selected date, across locations, categories and stages: the heatmap and hierarchy views, and the totals and percentages shown there.

nfr.statement: Time for the overview to load for the selected date and categories on a large project.
nfr.open_question: What p95 load time is acceptable, and on which project size? Current figures should come from frontend RUM and API traces.

requirements.title: Progress can be browsed through the site hierarchy
requirements.statement: Users can monitor progress through a hierarchical view of locations and their assets.

acceptance_criteria.given: A project with a building, two floors and assets on each floor
acceptance_criteria.when: A user opens the progress overview
acceptance_criteria.then: They can expand building to floor to see progress at each level

requirements.title: Overview counts only eligible data as of the selected day
requirements.statement: The overview includes only dates, assets and categories that are eligible on the selected day (active, tracked, live categories and visible snapshots). Support users also see inactive snapshots, so their totals can differ from a customer's for the same project.

acceptance_criteria.given: A structure with progress on an active snapshot (40 units) and an inactive snapshot (10 more units)
acceptance_criteria.when: A customer and a support user view the overview for the same day
acceptance_criteria.then: The customer sees 40, and the support user's total includes the inactive snapshot

requirements.title: Project totals are computed per view, not stored
requirements.statement: No single project-level percentage is stored. Each view sums the selected locations when it is requested, and the denominator depends on the view (overview, schedule and reports each build their own).

sources.title: Track3D "Single Source of Truth" docs, generated from code

acceptance_criteria.given: Two floors with 40/100 and 10/50 units of the same stage
acceptance_criteria.when: Both floors are selected in the overview
acceptance_criteria.then: The combined value is 50/150, calculated at request time

requirements.title: Show progress completed or progress remaining
requirements.statement: Users can switch the overview between progress completed and progress remaining.

acceptance_criteria.when: The user switches to progress remaining
acceptance_criteria.then: The stage shows 70 remaining (70%) instead of 30 completed (30%)

requirements.title: Category status heatmap
requirements.statement: The overview shows a grid heatmap of progress status by category for the selected date range.
open_checks: Displayed N/C, N/A, zero-with-asterisk values, differing date labels and overwritten takeoff need defined meanings

acceptance_criteria.given: A date range and categories are selected
acceptance_criteria.then: Each cell shows the correct progress status for that category and location

requirements.title: Select several categories, and remember the selection
requirements.statement: Users can select several categories and stages at once on the progress page. Each category has its own distinct colour, and the selection is remembered across sessions.

acceptance_criteria.when: The user views the progress page
acceptance_criteria.then: Each selected category has a distinct colour

acceptance_criteria.given: A user has selected categories and stages
acceptance_criteria.then: The same categories and stages are still selected
